facebook.caption:
Oct 20, 2026 remote Web3 catalog: top 5 explicit-country markets. A historical snapshot, not a claim these vacancies remain open. Most roles were country-restricted; multi-country rows count once per named country.

1. United States: 155 fully remote listings across 30 employers, the largest explicit-country count in the Oct 20 catalog. Eligibility comes from the role's stated location, not the employer's headquarters.

2. United Kingdom: 29 listings across 4 employers. In the Oct 20 catalog, the US had 126 more listings and 26 more employers. This is a comparison of explicitly eligible locations, not company headquarters.

3. Cyprus: 11 listings across 2 employers. Cyprus, Georgia and Poland tie on listing count in the Oct 20 catalog, but their employer counts differ: 2, 1 and 4 respectively.

4. Georgia: 11 listings, all from 1 employer in the Oct 20 catalog. Poland had the same listing count across 4 employers. Equal listing volume can hide very different employer concentration.

5. Poland: 11 listings across 4 employers in the Oct 20, 2026 catalog. Ranking excludes 6 worldwide and 180 unresolved-location listings. Multi-country listings count in each named country, so country totals overlap.
